data.title: A link that led somewhere else
data.goal: A link that led somewhere else

memoryNodes.cue: The familiar design raises a question.

data.situation:
A reader sent Jo a screenshot claiming the whole library would close. Its design was almost indistinguishable from the official notice, but the link led to an unfamiliar page. Nora would not call it a hoax until they had checked its authenticity. They compared the screenshot with the original file and asked the library office where it had come from. The reply showed that someone had copied an old notice and invented a new date. Jo replaced her vague note with a factual account of the difference. The story was compelling enough to hold attention; the evidence was compelling for a different reason, because it supported the correction. They did not need to make the false story more frightening to explain why it was wrong. Jo: The two designs are nearly indistinguishable.
Nora: Check the link and the date.
Jo: The office has confirmed that the screenshot is a hoax.
Nora: Then give readers a factual explanation of what changed.

readingBlocks.en: A reader sent Jo a screenshot claiming the whole library would close. Its design was almost indistinguishable from the official notice, but the link led to an unfamiliar page. Nora would not call it a hoax until they had checked its authenticity. They compared the screenshot with the original file and asked the library office where it had come from. The reply showed that someone had copied an old notice and invented a new date. Jo replaced her vague note with a factual account of the difference. The story was compelling enough to hold attention; the evidence was compelling for a different reason, because it supported the correction. They did not need to make the false story more frightening to explain why it was wrong.
readingBlocks.zh: 一位读者发来截图，声称整座图书馆会关闭。它的设计几乎与正式通知无法区分，链接却通往陌生页面。诺拉要先核查真实性，再判断是不是骗局。她们对照原文件，向图书馆办公室询问来源。回复表明，有人复制旧通知，并编造了新日期。乔把模糊笔记改成对差别的事实说明。故事吸引人，是因为它能抓住注意；证据令人信服，则是因为它支持了更正。她们无需把错误故事说得更可怕，也能说明它为何不对。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: The two designs are nearly indistinguishable.
Nora: Check the link and the date.
Jo: The office has confirmed that the screenshot is a hoax.
Nora: Then give readers a factual explanation of what changed.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：两个设计几乎分不出来。
诺拉：检查链接和日期。
乔：办公室已确认截图是骗局。
诺拉：那就按事实说明改动在哪里。
